applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 (southern portion of site)
findings.comment: Buildings 7 and 8 are located in close proximity to existing overhead electric conductors (O.H.U.L.) shown on the southern property boundary. No surveyed conductor elevations, building elevation sheets, or horizontal clearance dimensions are provided demonstrating that the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outside conductor is maintained. Building elevation sheets with dimensioned clearances from outside conductor to building face required.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 (southern portion of site); parking areas and structures within site boundary
findings.comment: Existing overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors are located along the southern property boundary adjacent to proposed buildings and parking areas. No dimension annotations, distance measurements, or verification exhibits are provided confirming that customer facilities (buildings, parking structures, transformers, pull boxes) maintain the required 15-foot radial clearance from the outside conductor of overhead distribution conductors. Clearance distance verification with dimensioned plan and section exhibits required.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 (roof eaves, overhangs, balconies projecting toward overhead utilities)
findings.comment: Building projections (roof eaves, overhangs, balconies) are shown on buildings located proximate to overhead electric conductors on the southern boundary. No building elevation sheets, section views, or dimension exhibits are provided verifying that projections maintain both the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance and the 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductors. Building elevation and section exhibits with all projection dimensions and clearance annotations required.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 adjacent to southern property boundary
findings.comment: Buildings 7 and 8 are proposed in proximity to the southern property boundary where existing overhead electric facilities (poles and O.H.U.L.) are located. No surveyed clearance dimensions, setback annotations, or verification that buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductors are provided. Clearance verification with dimension annotations and surveyed conductor locations required.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 (southern portion of site)
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets showing proposed buildings adjacent to overhead electric conductors are not provided, nor are surveyed conductor elevations and clearance dimensions shown on any sheets. Registered surveyor data for overhead conductor elevations and mid-span clearance measurements required on building elevation sheets to demonstrate compliance with clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8; southern driveway and parking areas
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits showing dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of buildings and site features are completely absent from the submitted plans. Overhead electric facilities are shown on the site plan but no clearance dimension annotations are provided from the outside conductor to building faces, driveways, parking areas, or other structures. Detailed section views and enlarged plan details with dimension lines from outside conductor to building edges and site features required.

applicableAreas: Proposed fencing along property perimeter
findings.comment: Proposed fencing is shown along property perimeter where overhead electric conductors exist. No dimension annotations are provided showing the clearance from the outside conductor of overhead facilities to fence lines or fence posts, measured horizontally to maintain the required 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance. Dimension annotations on site plan or detail sheets showing clearance from outside conductor to fence alignment required.

applicableAreas: Proposed fencing along property perimeter near utility poles
findings.comment: Multiple overhead electric poles are located along the property perimeter boundaries. Proposed fence locations are shown on the site plan but no specific dimension annotations are provided confirming that fence posts maintain the required minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from overhead electric poles. Dimension annotations showing post-to-pole distances required on site plan or fence detail sheets.

applicableAreas: Proposed vehicle barrier fencing along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Vehicle barrier fencing is proposed along the southern property boundary where overhead electric lines are located (O.H.U.L.). No vertical or horizontal clearance verification exhibits are provided. Section views with clearance dimensions from outermost electric conductor to barrier fence top, and plan views showing horizontal clearances, required to verify minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls adjacent to southern property boundary
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on site plan along property boundaries where overhead electric conductors are located. No dimension annotations are provided on the site plan or wall detail sheets showing the clearance from the outside conductor to the retaining wall face, measured horizontally to verify the required 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance. Clearance dimensions from outside conductor to wall face required on site plan or section detail sheets.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls adjacent to overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Section exhibits showing retaining wall details are provided on Sheets 38-39, but none include dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of the retaining wall. No clearance dimension annotations showing horizontal distance from outside conductor to wall face are present. Section views with clearance dimensions from outside conductor to wall face required.

applicableAreas: Southern driveway loop and parking areas
findings.comment: The southern driveway and parking areas are located in close proximity to existing overhead electric lines (O.H.U.L.) on the southern property boundary. Grading plan shows driveway grades but no vertical clearance dimensions are provided from the lowest point of overhead conductors to finished driveway surfaces. No mid-span clearance data or section views showing the required minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (areas with truck traffic) vertical clearance are provided. Section views with vertical clearance dimensions and determination of truck traffic classification required.

applicableAreas: Parking areas beneath overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Parking areas on site are located beneath or adjacent to overhead electric lines. No vertical clearance dimensions are provided on site plan or section views from lowest overhead line to parking surface, and no note regarding the clearance requirement is included on plans. Section views with vertical clearance dimensions and plan note confirming adequate clearance required.

applicableAreas: Southern driveway and parking areas near existing poles
findings.comment: Existing electric poles are shown on the southern property boundary where proposed driveways and parking are located. No relocation notes are provided, nor are there dimension annotations confirming that poles are relocated to maintain minimum 30-foot distance from driveway edge. Verification of pole relocation (minimum 30 feet from driveway edge) or engineer notes addressing conflict resolution required.

applicableAreas: Throughout site plan and all utility plan sheets
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown anywhere on the plans from the outside conductor of overhead electric lines to proposed site features. Where dimensions are absent, this deficiency cannot be assessed; however, the complete lack of dimension annotations from outside conductors to buildings, driveways, parking areas, fences, trees, and retaining walls constitutes a failure to provide the required clearance verification. All clearance dimensions must originate from outside conductor location, not pole centerline. Comprehensive dimension annotations required on all relevant plan sheets.

applicableAreas: Exterior lighting throughout site
findings.comment: Proposed exterior streetlight poles and site lighting are shown on landscape and site plans in proximity to existing overhead electric lines. No specific dimension annotations or clarification notes are provided confirming that new streetlight poles are located outside the routing of overhead electric lines or maintaining adequate clearance from overhead conductors. Confirmation that streetlight poles avoid overhead line routing, or clearance dimensions from outside conductor, required.

applicableAreas: Proposed sidewalks along Valley View Road frontage
findings.comment: Existing power poles are located at property boundaries along Valley View Road where sidewalks are proposed. No plan notation or dimension annotations confirm that sidewalks are cleared (adequate horizontal distance maintained) from existing power poles at each end of the property along the right-of-way frontage. Clarification that sidewalks avoid pole locations or dimensions showing clearance from sidewalk to pole required.

applicableAreas: Trash enclosure locations on site
findings.comment: Trash enclosure locations are shown on the site plan in proximity to overhead electric lines. No dimensions or clearance verification is provided confirming that enclosed trash areas and receptacles are positioned to maintain minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance from overhead conductors, considering that trash bins raised during service may contact overhead lines. Clearance dimensions considering full height of raised trash containers required.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8; driveway; parking areas; all structures within electric easements
findings.comment: Multiple electric easements (5-ft and 10-ft width) are indicated on the property survey and plat (Sheet 2). Proposed buildings, driveway, parking, and utility features must not be installed under or over overhead distribution facilities, and items within electric easements must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductors. No easement exhibit is provided showing easement boundaries in relation to proposed structures, and no clearance dimensions from outside conductor to features within easements are shown. Easement exhibit with boundaries clearly delineated and clearance dimensions from outside conductor to all structures/features required.

applicableAreas: Water meter locations at utility tap points
findings.comment: Water meter locations are shown on utility tap sheets (Sheets 19-20) and electrical design plan (Sheet 21) but no clearance dimensions are provided from water meter locations to existing overhead electric service lines (service-drop conductors) located on the southern boundary. Clearance dimensions from outside conductor of service drops to water meter locations required.

applicableAreas: Water and wastewater utility lines throughout site
findings.comment: Proposed water and wastewater lines are shown on utility tap plans, but no dimension annotations or profile views show clearance distances from these lines to existing overhead electrical distribution facilities and poles on the southern boundary. Dimension annotations on utility plan showing clearance distances from overhead pole locations to water/wastewater line routing required.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 near southern property line
findings.comment: Buildings 7 and 8 are proposed within 30-50 feet of the southern property line where existing overhead electric facilities are located. No documentation confirms that permanent structure foundations maintain sufficient clearance (typically 5 feet minimum from property line) to allow adequate clearance space for electric facilities and infrastructure. Verification of foundation setbacks from property line and coordination with utility clearance requirements needed.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8; southern driveway and parking areas
findings.comment: Vertical clearances from proposed site features (buildings, driveways) to overhead electric lines appear potentially marginal based on site plan data and existing overhead line routing shown on southern boundary. No registered surveyor data showing pole locations, conductor elevations, or mid-span clearances is provided to verify that minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearances (horizontal) and 16-18 foot vertical clearances (for driveways) are maintained. Registered surveyor mid-span clearance survey with conductor elevation data required.

applicableAreas: Exterior decorative lighting throughout site
findings.comment: Proposed decorative landscape lighting is shown on site plan and landscape plan in proximity to overhead electric lines on southern boundary. No dimension annotations or clearance verification are provided confirming that decorative light fixtures maintain the required 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from outside electric conductors, or noting relocation. Clearance dimensions or relocation notes for decorative lighting near overhead lines required.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where trees are proposed near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Proposed new trees (10 Cedar Elm, 2 Live Oak, 6 Mexican Redbud, 2 Texas Mountain Laurel) are shown planted approximately 10-20 feet from the overhead electric line on the southern boundary (Sheet 31). No utility-compatible (UC) species designations are provided on the landscape plan, and no documentation confirms species comply with ECM Appendix F utility-compatible requirements. Cedar Elm and Live Oak are typically NOT utility-compatible species for distribution lines due to mature height exceeding 20 feet. Landscape plan must clearly mark all trees near overhead utilities with UC designations, species verified against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible list, and minimum 10-foot lateral distance confirmed for distribution (50 feet for transmission).

applicableAreas: Electric meter locations on site
findings.comment: Electric meter locations are shown on the preliminary electrical design plan (Sheet 21), but no enlarged details or obstruction verification is provided confirming that meters are not obstructed by buildings, fences, landscaping, or other site features. Working clearance requirements (30-inch wide front space, 36-inch front depth, 6.5-foot headroom per UCM § 1.10.9) cannot be verified. Enlarged detail drawings showing meter locations with clearance zones and obstruction verification required.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 near existing streetlights
findings.comment: Existing streetlight poles may be located at property boundaries along Valley View Road. Proposed buildings are shown on the site plan, but no dimension annotations or clearance verification is provided confirming required clearances from buildings to existing streetlight poles. Dimension annotations showing building-to-pole clearances, or confirmation that streetlights do not conflict with proposed structures, required.

applicableAreas: Proposed driveways and accessible paths throughout site
findings.comment: Down guy wires (support cables from poles to ground anchors) from existing distribution poles on the property boundary may conflict with proposed accessible paths and driveways shown on the site plan. The existing conditions survey shows guy anchors at several poles, but these are frequently omitted from or unclear on proposed plans. No notation or detail confirms whether down guy anchor points and guy wire routing are resolved through pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting structures. Verification that proposed paths and driveways avoid guy wire conflicts required; if conflicts exist, note resolution method (pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting pole).

applicableAreas: Pad-mounted transformers and equipment on site
findings.comment: Pad-mounted transformer equipment is shown on the site plan and electrical design plan (Sheet 21) but located in proximity to existing overhead electric lines on the southern boundary (based on overhead line routing shown). No vertical clearance dimensions are provided from overhead line conductors to top of transformer equipment. Section view showing vertical clearance from outside conductor to top of transformer required to verify minimum 7.5-foot clearance.

applicableAreas: Construction staging areas and equipment operation zones throughout site
findings.comment: Erosion and sedimentation control plan (Sheet 5) shows construction limits and potential staging areas near overhead electric lines on the southern boundary. No documentation confirms that construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, and work platforms maintain the minimum 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines as required by OSHA 1910.333 and UCM § 1.10.2. This is distinct from permanent clearance requirements. Construction logistics plan with 10-foot radial clearance zone marked around overhead utilities required.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general site plan notes
findings.comment: High-voltage overhead electric lines exist on and adjacent to the site. No plan note is provided requiring that owner/contractor notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines as mandated by Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. Required 48-hour notification note must be added to cover sheet or general notes.

applicableAreas: Electric service mast locations at buildings
findings.comment: Service mast locations connecting to the underground electrical service are indicated on the site plan and electrical design plan but building elevations showing service mast through-roof installations, roof clearance dimensions, and distance from roof edge are not provided. Building elevation sheets with service mast locations, clearance dimensions (minimum 3-foot above roof, or 18-inch if within 4 feet of roof edge), and voltage designation (≤300V applicability) required.
